تستلمين (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِمِينَ (tastalimīna) /tas.ta.li.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# تُسْتَلَمِينَ (tustalamīna) /tus.ta.la.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
